description: Gross weekly, monthly and annual pay at a state's minimum wage on a date in 2026-2027, for given hours per week (default 40) and weeks per year (default 52). Uses the state rate in force on that date (with the federal floor where it applies). Pre-tax; ignores overtime and tips.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD between 2026-01-01 and 2027-12-31. Defaults to today.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, or DC. Examples: "California", "TX", "District of Columbia".

name: annual_income_at_minimum_wage
title: Annual income at minimum wage
